reason: Record the exact route-custody, pending-response, local publication-context, and independent validator implementation truth.

operation.summary: Resolved authority-protocol review by making actual OpenRaft apply indices and the verified route cut's exact polis, membership epoch, authority cut, and boot generations the replicated commit authority; valid finalize apply returns pending with no token, and only runtime-held local identity, root, and checkpoint authority may publish after reconciliation.
changes: Bound production PrepareAuthority to the state-held verified route cut's exact polis id and membership epoch as well as its authority membership and boot generations, with real OpenRaft rejection of relabeled polis, epoch, and self-consistent wrong authority cuts.

Kept Guardian signer custody opaque, crate-private, runtime-local, and non-serialized; signatures bind guardian, certificate generation, boot generation, membership index, intent digest, committed prepare index, and finalization time, while actual finalize apply index is separately verified and recorded.
Made valid committed finalize return a fail-closed authority_publication_pending response with no token, artifact, projection, or authority-restoring read.

Removed caller-selected publication identity, root, and checkpoint authority from the public reconcile method; each store uses only its configured local voter context and proves fake-node, fake-root, fake-CAS, retry, and restart denial or reconciliation.
Retained direct protocol fault cases under cfg(test), kept production legacy command shapes fail-closed, and preserved exclusive voter-certificate not_after plus inclusive intent deadline boundaries.

Made the v6 validator independently enforce exact ordered canonical 47 case names, expected results, and marker hashes, with built-in substitution and reorder rejection in both full and shallow validation.

validation.purpose: Prove the exact selected 47-case contract denominator.
Prove real three-voter OpenRaft prepare/finalize, pending response, exact route custody, local reconcile/restart, and substitution denial.
Prove the production library is warning-free without test-only authority helpers.
Prove legacy caller-indexed authority command shapes fail closed through the public production type.
Prove the independent exact-case contract and immutable packet in full and depth-one history.
Prove typed card projections and lifecycle record consistency.
